name: @mains/bridge
description: Ciphertext-only Bridge hub for local Cloudflare Workers development

scripts.staging:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply AUTH_DB --config wrangler.staging.jsonc --remote
scripts.production:build: npm run production:check && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.jsonc --profile mains-production --dry-run --outdir dist/production
scripts.production:migrate: npm run production:check && wrangler d1 migrations apply AUTH_DB --config wrangler.production.jsonc --profile mains-production --remote
scripts.production:deploy: npm run production:check && tsx scripts/deploy.ts production
scripts.test:hosts: MAINS_BRIDGE_HOST_TESTS=1 vitest run test/hosts.test.ts test/auth-hosts.test.ts test/product-hosts.test.ts test/session-hosts.test.ts test/lan-hosts.test.ts test/value-hosts.test.ts test/subscription-hosts.test.ts
